title: Qualification
statementMd:
## Problem Statement

You are given integers $N,K$. It is guaranteed that the given integers satisfy $\displaystyle K \le \frac N2$.

For permutations $P=(P_1,P_2,\ldots,P_N),Q=(Q_1,Q_2,\ldots,Q_N)$ of $(1,2,\ldots,N)$, define $f(P,Q)$ as follows:

> $N$ people, person $1$ through person $N$, participated in $2$ contests, contest A and contest B. Person $i$ $(1\le i\le N)$ placed $P_i$-th in contest A and $Q_i$-th in contest B.
> 
> Consider choosing $2K$ of these $N$ people by the following $2$ selection methods.
> 
> - Method ①: Choose the $K$ people with the best ranks in contest A. Then, among the $N-K$ people not yet chosen, choose the $K$ people with the best ranks in contest B.
> - Method ②: Choose the $K$ people with the best ranks in contest B. Then, among the $N-K$ people not yet chosen, choose the $K$ people with the best ranks in contest A.
> 
> Let $f(P,Q)$ be the number of people who are chosen by method ① but not chosen by method ②.

There are $N!^2$ pairs $(P,Q)$ of permutations of $(1,2,\ldots,N)$. Find the sum of $f(P,Q)$ over all of them, modulo $998244353$.

You are given $T$ test cases; solve each of them.

## Constraints

- $1\le T\le 2\times 10^5$
- $2\le N\le 10^6$
- $\displaystyle 1\le K \le \frac N2$
- The sum of $N$ over all test cases is at most $10^6$.
- All input values are integers.

## Input

The input is given from Standard Input in the following format:

```
T
\text{case}_1
\text{case}_2
\vdots
\text{case}_T
```

Each test case is given in the following format:

```
N K
```

## Output

Print the answers to the test cases in order, separated by newlines.

{"titleZh":"资格","bodyZh":"## 题目描述

给定整数 $N,K$。保证给定的整数满足 $\displaystyle K \le \frac N2$。

对于 $(1,2,\ldots,N)$ 的排列 $P=(P_1,P_2,\ldots,P_N),Q=(Q_1,Q_2,\ldots,Q_N)$，定义 $f(P,Q)$ 如下：

> 有 $N$ 个人，编号为 $1$ 至 $N$，参加了 2 场比赛：比赛 A 和比赛 B。对于每个 $i$ $(1\le i\le N)$，第 $i$ 个人在比赛 A 中排名第 $P_i$，在比赛 B 中排名第 $Q_i$。
>
> 考虑使用以下 2 种选拔方式从这 $N$ 个人中选出 $2K$ 个人。
>
> - 方式 ①：选出比赛 A 中排名最靠前的 $K$ 个人。然后，在尚未被选中的 $N-K$ 个人中，选出比赛 B 中排名最靠前的 $K$ 个人。
> - 方式 ②：选出比赛 B 中排名最靠前的 $K$ 个人。然后，在尚未被选中的 $N-K$ 个人中，选出比赛 A 中排名最靠前的 $K$ 个人。
>
> 令 $f(P,Q)$ 表示通过方式 ① 选中、但未通过方式 ② 选中的人数。

共有 $N!^2$ 对 $(P,Q)$，其中 $P,Q$ 都是 $(1,2,\ldots,N)$ 的排列。求所有这些排列对的 $f(P,Q)$ 之和，结果对 $998244353$ 取模。

给定 $T$ 个测试用例，请分别求解。

## 约束条件

- $1\le T\le 2\times 10^5$
- $2\le N\le 10^6$
- $\displaystyle 1\le K \le \frac N2$
- 所有测试用例的 $N$ 之和不超过 $10^6$。
- 所有输入值均为整数。

## 输入格式

输入从标准输入按以下格式给出：

```
T
\text{case}_1
\text{case}_2
\vdots
\text{case}_T
```

每个测试用例按以下格式给出：

```
N K
```

## 输出格式

按顺序输出各个测试用例的答案，每个答案占一行。"}

samples.note:
Consider the $1$-st test case.

For example, when $P=(2,1,3),Q=(3,1,2)$, the people chosen by method ① are persons $2$ and $3$, and the people chosen by method ② are persons $1$ and $2$. Therefore, $f(P,Q)=1$ for this pair $P,Q$.

There are $6$ pairs $(P,Q)$ with $f(P,Q)=1$, and $f(P,Q)=0$ holds for the remaining $30$ pairs $(P,Q)$. Therefore, the answer is $6\times 1+30\times 0=6$.
